name: Gas
title: Multi-chain gas & fee estimator (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, OP, Polygon, BNB, Avalanche, Bitcoin, Solana)
description: Live gas prices and transaction cost in USD across EVM chains, Bitcoin sat/vB and Solana priority fees, read directly from public RPCs.

name: Units
title: Wei / Gwei / Ether, Sats / BTC, Lamports / SOL unit converter
description: Exact big-number conversion between wei, gwei, ether, satoshis, BTC, lamports and SOL — no floating point errors.

name: ABI
title: ABI encoder / decoder & function selector lookup
description: Encode Solidity function calls, decode calldata, compute 4-byte selectors and event topics, and look up unknown selectors in the openchain / 4byte signature databases.

name: Address/ENS
title: Ethereum address checksum validator, ENS resolver & contract inspector
description: Validate EIP-55 checksums, resolve ENS names (forward and reverse), and inspect any address on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, OP, Polygon, BNB or Avalanche: balance, nonce, contract code, proxy implementation, EIP-7702 delegation and ERC-20 metadata.

name: Tx decoder
title: Transaction decoder for Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Polygon, OP
description: Paste a transaction hash to decode the function call, arguments, event logs, status and fees on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Polygon, OP Mainnet, BNB Chain and Avalanche via public RPC.

name: Hash/Merkle
title: Keccak-256, SHA-256 hasher & OpenZeppelin Merkle tree builder
description: Hash text or hex with keccak256, sha256 and ripemd160, and build OpenZeppelin-compatible Merkle trees (StandardMerkleTree / SimpleMerkleTree) with root and proofs for airdrops and allowlists.

name: Storage slots
title: Solidity storage slot calculator (mappings, arrays, ERC-7201, EIP-1967)
description: Compute Solidity storage slots for mappings, nested mappings, dynamic arrays, ERC-7201 namespaces and EIP-1967 proxy slots — then read the live value from any EVM chain.

name: EIP/ERC/BIP
title: EIP / ERC / BIP quick reference — searchable index
description: Search every Ethereum EIP and ERC and every Bitcoin BIP by number, title or status. Rebuilt nightly from ethereum/EIPs, ethereum/ERCs and bitcoin/bips.

name: Chainlist
title: Chainlist — EVM chain IDs, RPC endpoints & explorers, add to wallet
description: Search 2,700+ EVM networks by name or chain ID, test public RPC latency live from your browser, and add a network to MetaMask/any EIP-3085 wallet.

name: Tokens
title: Token list lookup — find ERC-20 addresses by symbol across chains
description: Search the Uniswap default token list by symbol, name or address across Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, OP, Polygon, BNB and Avalanche, and verify any token's on-chain name, symbol, decimals and supply.

name: Safe multisig
title: Safe (Gnosis Safe) multisig tx builder & decoder — safeTxHash, MultiSend
description: Build a Safe transaction and compute its EIP-712 safeTxHash locally, cross-check against the Safe contract on-chain, read owners/threshold/nonce, and decode execTransaction or MultiSend batches.

name: EIP-712
title: EIP-712 typed data signer & verifier, EIP-191, ERC-1271
description: Hash EIP-712 typed data (digest, domain separator, struct hash), sign with a throwaway key or your wallet, recover the signer, verify personal_sign messages and check ERC-1271 smart-account signatures on-chain.

name: Calldata diff
title: Calldata diff — compare two transactions' calldata field by field
description: Decode two calldata blobs (or two tx hashes) with openchain/4byte signatures and highlight every argument and 32-byte word that differs.

name: Verification
title: Contract verification lookup — Sourcify & Blockscout
description: Check whether a smart contract's source code is verified on Sourcify (full/partial match) and Blockscout, with compiler version, licence, proxy type and implementation addresses.

name: Gas history
title: Gas price history charts — last 1,024 blocks on 7 EVM chains
description: Chart base fee, median priority tip and block fullness over the last 1,024 blocks for Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, OP, Polygon, BNB Chain and Avalanche, with min/median/p75/max stats.

name: Bridge fees
title: Bridge fee comparison — Across vs LI.FI vs Relay live quotes
description: Compare live quotes for bridging USDC or ETH between Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, OP and Polygon: amount received, fees and estimated time from Across, LI.FI and Relay.

name: Approvals
title: Token approval checker & revoke links
description: Check which popular spenders (Permit2, Uniswap, 1inch, 0x, CoW, Balancer, OpenSea, Aave…) can move an address's ERC-20 tokens, flag unlimited approvals, and get one-click revoke links and approve(spender, 0) calldata.

name: ENS bulk
title: ENS bulk resolver — resolve many names & reverse-lookup addresses
description: Resolve a list of ENS names to addresses (with avatar, url, Twitter, GitHub records) and reverse-resolve addresses to primary names, verifying forward/reverse match. Export as CSV.

name: Solana tx
title: Solana transaction decoder — instructions, balance & token changes
description: Decode any Solana transaction signature: status, fee, compute units, parsed instructions and inner instructions with program names (Jupiter, Raydium, Orca, Meteora, SPL Token…), SOL and token balance changes, and logs.

name: Bitcoin PSBT
title: Bitcoin PSBT & raw transaction decoder
description: Decode a Bitcoin PSBT (BIP-174, base64 or hex) or raw transaction: inputs, outputs, addresses, script types, fee and fee rate, signatures present, BIP-32 derivation paths. Runs offline in your browser.

name: Address labels
title: Address labels — who is this address? Blockscout tags, ENS, OFAC check
description: Look up public labels for an EVM address: Blockscout contract name and public tags, token info, ENS primary name, Uniswap token-list match, well-known spender names, and an OFAC SDN sanctions check.

name: Vanity/CREATE2
title: Vanity address difficulty & time estimator + CREATE2 calculator
description: Estimate how many attempts and how long it takes to find an Ethereum vanity address prefix (case-insensitive or EIP-55 checksum), benchmarked live on your device, and compute CREATE2 deployment addresses.

name: Price impact
title: Uniswap v3 price impact calculator — live on-chain quotes
description: Quote a Uniswap v3 swap on-chain with QuoterV2 and see amount out, mid price, execution price, price impact, price after the trade, ticks crossed and gas estimate — Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, OP, Polygon.

name: MEV sandwich
title: MEV sandwich checker — was my swap sandwiched?
description: Paste an Ethereum/Base/Arbitrum/OP/Polygon transaction hash to check whether it was sandwiched: finds a front-run swap on the same pool in the same direction and a back-run reversing it from the same EOA or bot contract.

name: Stablecoins
title: Stablecoin peg & supply monitor — USDT, USDC, DAI, USDe…
description: Live stablecoin table: price vs peg, circulating supply, 7-day supply change, peg mechanism and chain count for 400+ stablecoins from DefiLlama.

name: RPC health
title: Public RPC health checker — latency & block lag for free endpoints
description: Test free public RPC endpoints for Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, OP, Polygon, BNB Chain and Avalanche from your browser: reachability, latency, chain ID and how many blocks behind the best endpoint each is. Plus the nightly server-side probe.
